_readme: The feature registry for the ajit-segment-bots blueprint.
This is the single source the diagram is drawn from. Nothing is hand-drawn:
the generator reads this file and computes the edges, so the picture cannot
drift from the contract.
THE RULE THAT KEEPS THE FLOW CLEAN AS PARTS ARE ADDED:
a feature never names another feature. It names only the data it consumes and
the data it produces. Two features are connected when, and only when, one
produces a data type the other consumes. A new part therefore cannot invent a
new private wire to an old part -- it can only attach to data that already
exists, or declare new data of its own. That is what makes a part replaceable:
swap any feature for a better one that honours the same consumes/produces
contract and nothing else in the system changes.
data_types[] fields:
id          stable identifier, referenced by features
name        what a person calls it
description one line: what this data actually carries
features[] fields:
id          stable identifier, kebab-case
name        what a person calls this part
role        one line: what the part is responsible for
stage       which band of the flow it sits in (see stages[])
consumes    data_type ids it reads   (may be empty for a source)
produces    data_type ids it emits   (may be empty for a sink)
replaces    optional: the id of an earlier part this one supersedes
The user supplies the features. They are never invented here.
